## Introduction

Label-free LC-MS/MS proteomics (PRIDE: PXD077193) of high-granularity (HG) cells and microglia sorted from the brains of AEC-treated mice (n = 5 per group). The aim is to identify proteins that distinguish HG cells from microglia. Differential abundance is tested with limma and DEqMS, followed by over-representation analysis (g:Profiler) and GSEA (GO).

**Input files**

| File                                  | Location           | Content                                                                                        |
|------------------------|------------------------|------------------------|
| `CPMSF_GPPF-YG-211_CF211_Report.xlsx` | `data/proteomics/` | Protein report from the proteomics facility (sheet 2: protein-group quantities and PSM counts) |
| `Fig1b_sc_all.rds`                    | `data/scrna/`      | Annotated single-cell Seurat object, used only to build the CIBERSORTx reference               |

All outputs are written to `results/proteomics/`.

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(matrixStats)
library(limma)
library(DEqMS)
library(UniProt.ws)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(gprofiler2)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(plotly)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(htmltools)
library(DT)
library(Glimma)
library(Seurat)

# Paths
data_dir    <- "data/proteomics"
sc_dir      <- "data/scrna"
results_dir <- "results/proteomics"
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
report_file <- file.path(data_dir, "CPMSF_GPPF-YG-211_CF211_Report.xlsx")

# Analysis parameters
p_column    <- "sca.P.Value"   # column used for significance; "sca.adj.pval" for BH-adjusted
p_cutoff    <- 0.05
lfc_cutoff  <- 1
max_missing <- 1               # proteins may be missing in at most 1 of 5 samples per group

de_colours <- c(UP = "#BE0B1C", DOWN = "#282973", NO = "grey")

set.seed(1)
```

## Data

### Samples

The report contains 10 samples used in this analysis (HG1–5 and Mic1–5) and three low-yield pilot HG samples, which are excluded. HG cells and microglia were sorted from the same five mice, so HGn and Micn come from mouse n. Column positions refer to sheet 2 of the report; the column names actually read are printed below so they can be checked.

```{r samples}
samples <- tibble(
  sample = c(paste0("HG", 1:5), paste0("Mic", 1:5)),
  group  = factor(rep(c("HG", "Microglia"), each = 5), levels = c("Microglia", "HG")),
  mouse  = factor(rep(paste0("M", 1:5), times = 2))
)

quant_cols <- 43:52   # protein quantities, same order as `samples` (pilots in 53:55 not used)
psm_cols   <- 17:26   # PSM counts, same order as `samples`

report <- read_excel(report_file, sheet = 2)

tibble(sample       = samples$sample,
       quantity_col = colnames(report)[quant_cols],
       psm_col      = colnames(report)[psm_cols]) %>%
  knitr::kable()

dplyr::select(samples, sample, group, mouse) %>% knitr::kable()
```

### Load and normalise

Intensities are log2-transformed and median-normalised. Zero intensities are treated as missing.

```{r load}
to_matrix <- function(df) {
  m <- as.matrix(mutate(df, across(everything(), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x)))))
  dimnames(m) <- list(report$PG.ProteinGroups, samples$sample)
  m
}

intensity <- to_matrix(report[, quant_cols])
intensity[intensity == 0] <- NA
psm <- to_matrix(report[, psm_cols])

# Keep proteins detected in at least one of the 10 samples
detected  <- rowSums(!is.na(intensity)) > 0
intensity <- intensity[detected, ]
psm       <- psm[detected, ]

log_int  <- log2(intensity)
norm_int <- equalMedianNormalization(log_int)
```

### Protein annotation

Gene symbols are retrieved from UniProt for the first accession of each protein group. The lookup is cached in `results/proteomics/uniprot_annotation.csv`, so later runs reuse the same mapping.

```{r annotation}
first_accession <- sapply(strsplit(rownames(intensity), ";"), `[`, 1)

annot_file <- file.path(results_dir, "uniprot_annotation.csv")
if (file.exists(annot_file)) {
  uniprot_annot <- read.csv(annot_file)
} else {
  up <- UniProt.ws(taxId = 10090)   # Mus musculus
  uniprot_annot <- UniProt.ws::select(up,
                                      keys    = unique(first_accession),
                                      columns = c("gene_names", "protein_name"),
                                      keytype = "UniProtKB")
  write.csv(uniprot_annot, annot_file, row.names = FALSE)
}

protein_annot <- tibble(
  protein_group = rownames(intensity),
  accession     = first_accession,
  gene_name     = sapply(strsplit(uniprot_annot$Gene.Names[match(first_accession, uniprot_annot$From)], " "), `[`, 1),
  protein_name  = uniprot_annot$Protein.names[match(first_accession, uniprot_annot$From)]
)
gene_of <- setNames(protein_annot$gene_name, protein_annot$protein_group)
```


### PCA

PCA on proteins quantified in all 10 samples.

```{r pca}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4
complete <- na.omit(norm_int)
pca <- prcomp(t(complete), center = TRUE)
var_explained <- round(100 * summary(pca)$importance["Proportion of Variance", ], 1)

pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca$x) %>%
  mutate(sample = rownames(.), group = samples$group)

p_pca <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sample), vjust = -1, size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "gray65", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "gray65", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = paste0("PCA (", nrow(complete), " proteins quantified in all samples)"),
       x = paste0("PC1 (", var_explained["PC1"], "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", var_explained["PC2"], "%)"),
       colour = NULL) +
  theme_classic()

p_pca
ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "PCA.pdf"), p_pca, width = 6, height = 5)
```

## Differential abundance

Proteins quantified in at least 4 of 5 samples in both groups are tested with limma. Because both cell types come from the same mice, the model includes mouse as a blocking factor (`~ 0 + group + mouse`), so the HG–microglia difference is estimated within each mouse. DEqMS then adjusts the variance estimates for the number of PSMs per protein (minimum non-zero PSM count across samples).

```{r deqms}
missing_hg  <- rowSums(is.na(norm_int[, samples$group == "HG"]))
missing_mic <- rowSums(is.na(norm_int[, samples$group == "Microglia"]))
de_input <- norm_int[missing_hg <= max_missing & missing_mic <= max_missing, ]

# Paired design: mouse as a blocking factor
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group + mouse, data = samples)
colnames(design) <- sub("^group", "", colnames(design))
contrast <- makeContrasts(HG - Microglia, levels = design)

fit <- lmFit(de_input, design) %>%
  contrasts.fit(contrast) %>%
  eBayes()

psm_nonzero <- psm[rownames(de_input), ]
psm_nonzero[psm_nonzero == 0] <- NA
fit$count <- rowMins(psm_nonzero, na.rm = TRUE)
fit <- spectraCounteBayes(fit)
```

```{r variance-plots}
VarianceBoxplot(fit, n = 30, xlab = "PSM count")
VarianceScatterplot(fit)
```

```{r results}
results <- outputResult(fit, coef_col = 1) %>%
  dplyr::rename(protein_group = gene) %>%
  left_join(protein_annot, by = "protein_group") %>%
  mutate(diffexpressed = case_when(
    .data[[p_column]] <= p_cutoff & logFC >  lfc_cutoff ~ "UP",
    .data[[p_column]] <= p_cutoff & logFC < -lfc_cutoff ~ "DOWN",
    TRUE ~ "NO"
  ) %>% factor(levels = c("NO", "UP", "DOWN")))

table(results$diffexpressed)

results %>%
  dplyr::select(protein_group, gene_name, protein_name, logFC, AveExpr, count,
                sca.t, sca.P.Value, sca.adj.pval, diffexpressed) %>%
  arrange(sca.P.Value) %>%
  write.csv(file.path(results_dir, "DEqMS_HG_vs_Microglia.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

Positive log2 fold change means higher abundance in HG cells.

```{r volcano-interactive}
threshold_label <- paste0(p_column, " < ", p_cutoff, " & |log2FC| > ", lfc_cutoff)

p_vol <- ggplot(arrange(results, diffexpressed),
                aes(logFC, -log10(.data[[p_column]]), colour = diffexpressed, text = gene_name)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = de_colours) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_cutoff), colour = "gray65", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cutoff, lfc_cutoff), colour = "gray65", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "log2 fold change (HG / microglia)", y = paste0("-log10 ", p_column),
       title = "HG vs microglia", subtitle = threshold_label) +
  theme_classic()

p_vol_html <- ggplotly(p_vol, tooltip = c("text", "x", "y"))
saveWidget(p_vol_html, file.path(results_dir, "Volcano_interactive.html"), selfcontained = TRUE)
p_vol_html
```

```{r volcano-labelled}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
top_up   <- results %>% filter(diffexpressed == "UP")   %>% slice_max(logFC, n = 10) %>% pull(gene_name)
top_down <- results %>% filter(diffexpressed == "DOWN") %>% slice_min(logFC, n = 10) %>% pull(gene_name)

status <- as.character(results$diffexpressed)
key_colours <- de_colours[status]
names(key_colours) <- c(UP = "UP", DOWN = "DOWN", NO = "Not sig.")[status]

p_vol_lab <- EnhancedVolcano(results,
                             x = "logFC", y = p_column,
                             lab = results$gene_name,
                             selectLab = c(top_up, top_down, "Alox15"),
                             title = "HG vs microglia", subtitle = threshold_label, caption = NULL,
                             pCutoff = p_cutoff, FCcutoff = lfc_cutoff,
                             colCustom = key_colours, colAlpha = 0.6, pointSize = 2,
                             ylab = bquote(~ -Log[10] ~ italic(P)),
                             drawConnectors = TRUE, widthConnectors = 0.7, colConnectors = "black",
                             boxedLabels = TRUE, labSize = 3) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

p_vol_lab
ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "Volcano.pdf"), p_vol_lab, width = 8, height = 5)
```

```{r results-table}
results %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_name, protein_name, logFC, sca.P.Value, sca.adj.pval, count, diffexpressed) %>%
  arrange(sca.adj.pval) %>%
  datatable(caption = "Differentially abundant proteins, HG vs microglia") %>%
  formatSignif(c("logFC", "sca.P.Value", "sca.adj.pval"), digits = 3)
```

## Enrichment analysis

### Over-representation analysis (g:Profiler)

```{r gprofiler}
run_gost <- function(direction, title) {
  genes <- results %>% filter(diffexpressed == direction, !is.na(gene_name)) %>% pull(gene_name) %>% unique()
  go <- gost(genes, organism = "mmusculus", evcodes = TRUE)
  if (is.null(go)) return(invisible(NULL))

  go$result %>%
    dplyr::select(term_name, term_id, source, p_value, term_size, query_size,
                  intersection_size, precision, recall, intersection) %>%
    write.csv(file.path(results_dir, paste0("gprofiler_", direction, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  gostplot(go, interactive = TRUE) %>% layout(title = title)
}

run_gost("UP",   "Terms enriched in proteins higher in HG cells")
run_gost("DOWN", "Terms enriched in proteins higher in microglia")
```

### GSEA (GO)

Proteins ranked by log2 fold change; positive NES means the term is enriched in HG cells.

```{r gsea}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 9
ranks <- results %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene_name)) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(logFC))) %>%
  distinct(gene_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%   # one entry per gene, strongest change kept
  arrange(desc(logFC)) %>%
  { setNames(.$logFC, .$gene_name) }

gse <- gseGO(geneList = ranks, ont = "ALL", OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "SYMBOL",
             by = "fgsea", eps = 0, seed = TRUE)
write.csv(gse@result, file.path(results_dir, "GSEA_GO.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

dotplot(gse, showCategory = 10, split = ".sign") + facet_grid(. ~ .sign)
```

```{r gsea-table}
datatable(gse@result, caption = "GSEA results (GO)")
```

## Selected proteins

```{r protein-plots}
#| fig-ncol: 2
#| fig-width: 4
#| fig-height: 3
plot_protein <- function(gene) {
  rows <- which(gene_of[rownames(norm_int)] == gene)
  if (length(rows) == 0) stop(gene, " not found")
  df <- tibble(sample = samples$sample, group = samples$group,
               value  = norm_int[rows[1], ])

  ggplot(df, aes(group, value, colour = group)) +
    geom_boxplot(staplewidth = 0.2, width = 0.3) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(title = gene, x = NULL, y = "Normalised log2 intensity") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}

for (gene in c("Alox15", "P2ry12")) {
  p <- plot_protein(gene)
  print(p)
  ggsave(file.path(results_dir, paste0(gene, ".pdf")), p, width = 4, height = 3)
}
```

### Cytokine receptors

Row z-scores of normalised log2 intensity; white means not detected.

```{r receptor-heatmap}
receptors <- c("Csf2ra", "Csf1r", "Il1r1", "Il1r2", "Il1rap", "Il3ra", "Il4r", "Il6ra",
               "Tgfbr1", "Tgfbr2", "Tgfbr3", "Tnfrsf1a", "Tnfrsf1b")

rows <- match(receptors, gene_of[rownames(norm_int)])
mat  <- norm_int[rows[!is.na(rows)], , drop = FALSE]
rownames(mat) <- receptors[!is.na(rows)]
mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(mat)))

ht <- Heatmap(mat_scaled,
              name = "Row z-score",
              col = colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#4575B4", "#FFFFBF", "#D73027")),
              na_col = "white",
              cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
              top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(Group = samples$group))
lgd_na <- Legend(labels = "Not detected", legend_gp = gpar(fill = "white"), border = "black")

draw(ht, annotation_legend_list = list(lgd_na), merge_legends = TRUE)

pdf(file.path(results_dir, "Cytokine_receptors_heatmap.pdf"), width = 4, height = 5)
draw(ht, annotation_legend_list = list(lgd_na), merge_legends = TRUE)
dev.off()
```
